title: Evaluation of tumor-derived exosome-induced dendritic cell dysfunction in mouse
author: Zeng, Yin, et al.
materials: PKH67 Green Fluorescent Cell Linker Midi Kit
MojoSort Mouse CD8 T cell Isolation Kit

steps.title: Prepare exosome‑depleted FBS
steps.instruction: Centrifuge regular fetal bovine serum at 100,000 × g for 2 h at 4 °C, collect the supernatant and store it for making RPMI‑1640 medium; this exosome‑depleted FBS is required for all downstream exosome isolations.

steps.title: Make tribromo‑ethanol anesthesia
steps.instruction: Prepare 20 mL of tribromo‑ethanol anesthesia as follows:

substeps.instruction: Weigh 0.25 g 2,2,2‑tribromo‑ethanol and dissolve in 0.5 mL 2‑methyl‑2‑butanol; vortex to mix.
Heat 19.5 mL ddH₂O to 50 °C.
Combine the two solutions, continue heating at 50 °C for 20 min.
Sterilize the final solution through a 0.22 µm filter and store at 4 °C (stable up to 6 months).

steps.title: Prepare antibody mixes for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Create the four antibody panels listed below, using the indicated final dilutions and volumes.

substeps.instruction: BMDC panel – add 1 µL APC‑CD11c (N418, 1/100), 5 µL FITC‑MHC II (C, 5/114, 1/150), 2 µL APC‑CD11b (M1/70, 1/4000).
OT‑I CD8⁺ T‑cell panel – add 1 µL PE‑TCR Vα2 (B20.11, 1/100), 1 µL APC‑CD8a (53‑6.7, 1/100).

Lymph‑node DC panel – add 0.5 µL BV605‑CD45 (30‑F11, 1/2000), 0.5 µL PE‑CD11b (M1/70, 1/4000), 0.25 µL PerCP‑Cyanine5.5‑Ly6C (HK, 1/2000), 0.5 µL PE‑Cy7‑MHC II (C, 1/4000), 0.5 µL BV785‑F4/80 (BM8, 1/2000), 1 µL APC‑Cy7‑CD11c (N418, 1/100).
OT‑I proliferation panel – add 1 µL PE‑CD11c (N418, 1/100), 1 µL APC‑CD8a (53‑6.7, 1/100), 0.5 µL PE‑Cy7‑CD317 (A21, 1/2000).

steps.title: Isolate tumor‑derived exosomes (TDEs)
steps.instruction: Harvest exosomes from MC38 tumor‑cell conditioned medium:

substeps.instruction: Culture MC38 cells in RPMI‑1640 supplemented with 10 % exosome‑depleted FBS; when cells reach ~80 % confluence (≈48 h), collect the supernatant (≈20 mL).
Centrifuge the collected medium at 3,000 × g for 2 h at 4 °C to remove cell debris.
Transfer the cleared supernatant to a sterile 100 kDa molecular‑weight‑cut‑off (MWCO) filter unit and centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C; discard the flow‑through (>100 kDa fraction).
Collect the retained pellet (brown‑colored exosome pellet).
Optional: characterize the pellet by dynamic light scattering (size, polydispersity index) and Western blot as shown in the original figure.

steps.title: Isolate splenic CD8⁺ T cells
steps.instruction: Obtain OT‑I CD8⁺ T cells from a transgenic mouse and prepare them for CFSE labeling:

substeps.instruction: Terminally anesthetize the mouse by cervical dislocation.
Excise the spleen and place it on a 70 µm cell strainer atop a 50 mL tube.
Grind the spleen with a syringe plunger while flushing the strainer with 10 mL RPMI‑1640 (no FBS).
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 3 mL 1× RBC‑lysis buffer, incubate 3–5 min with intermittent swirling.
Neutralize lysis by adding 30 mL RPMI‑1640 (or HBSS) (10× the lysis buffer volume), mix, and pass through a 70 µm strainer again.
Repeat the 500–600 × g, 5 min, 4 °C spin and discard supernatant to obtain splenocytes.
Resuspend splenocytes in 1× Mojo buffer to a density of 1 × 10⁷–1 × 10⁸ cells / mL (≈0.4 mL per spleen) and transfer to a 5 mL round‑bottom tube.
Add 10 µL biotin‑conjugated antibody cocktail per 100 µL cells, mix, incubate on ice 15 min.
Add 10 µL nano‑beads per 100 µL cells, mix, incubate on ice 15 min.
Add 2 mL 1× Mojo buffer, place tube on a magnetic stand for 5 min at 25 °C.
Collect the magnet‑unbound fraction (enriched CD8⁺ T cells) into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant; typically 1–2 × 10⁷ CD8⁺ T cells are recovered per mouse.
Optional: verify phenotype (TCR Vα2⁺ CD8⁺) by flow cytometry.
Resuspend cells in 50 µL Fc‑block buffer, incubate 5–10 min at 25 °C.
Add anti‑mouse CD8a APC (1/100) and anti‑mouse TCR Vα2 PE (1/100), mix, incubate 20 min at 4 °C.
Neutralize with 1 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in FACS buffer containing 1/1000 DAPI (0.1 µg/mL) for live‑cell gating; retain 5–10 % of cells unlabeled as a non‑CFSE control.

steps.title: CFSE label CD8⁺ T cells
steps.instruction: Stain the purified OT‑I CD8⁺ T cells with CFSE:

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 10 µM CFSE solution (CFSE diluted in 1× PBS) and mix thoroughly.
Incubate 10 min at 25 °C in the dark.
Quench labeling by adding 0.2–0.5 mL FBS.
Centrifuge 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in RPMI‑1640 containing 10 % FBS (BI) and 55 µM β‑mercaptoethanol; count cells for downstream assays.
